title: Astral Grimoire: 44 Track PC-98 Fantasy RPG Music Pack
tagline: 44 PC-98 style fantasy RPG music tracks for any engine. MIDI and OGG, loops.
description:
Astral Grimoire is a 44 track fantasy RPG music pack for any game engine, written to the sound budget of a late 1980s PC-98 computer.

It ships 38 full looping pieces and 6 short cues as OGG and editable MIDI, royalty free for commercial games, with three full tracks free on this page.

What is inside

44 tracks · 38 loops · 6 cues · OGG + editable MIDI · 53:53

  • One fantasy RPG from title screen to staff roll: towns and a night market, fields by day and night, forest, cave, desert, a frozen pass, a sky ship, five dungeons, a shrine, an inn, a shop, a guild, three character themes, a battle set of three, four bosses, the parting, the escape, the finale and the epilogue, plus 6 cues: Victory Fanfare, Game Over, Level Up, Item Get, Rest at the Inn and Danger.
  • The PC-98 sound board budget: six FM voices (lead, bass, counter line and a three note pad that plays the whole chord), one square wave arpeggio, and drums from the six sounds of the rhythm section only. Never more than 7 pitched notes at once.
  • The harmony moves: a new chord every bar, and a secondary dominant in every full piece (98 of them, each moving straight to its chord). The bridge of all 10 pieces in a major (ionian) key opens on IV, V, iii, vi.
  • One seed theme, Star, in every track, with four more cells for the witch, the road, the quiet places and the fights.
  • Every full piece loops (the shortest loop is 51.6 seconds), with LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags in its OGG file.
  • 31 pitched General MIDI instruments plus the drum kit, among them FM electric piano, distortion guitar, slap bass, trumpet, synth brass, ocarina, square lead and sawtooth lead. CHANNEL_MAP.md says which MIDI part is which FM or SSG channel.

The theory and audio reports (788 and 510 checks, 0 failed) and the channel budget check ship inside the download.

The channels: four bars of Battle drawn lane by lane from the shipped MIDI, with the count of notes sounding at every sixteenth.

The harmony: the chords of every full piece, each secondary dominant and the chord it resolves to marked.

The score sheet: all 44 tracks, from Astral Grimoire to Danger.

Works with

RPG Maker MV and MZ read the loop tags with no plugin. The Readme gives import steps for Godot 4 (followed in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files), Unity and GameMaker. Any engine that plays OGG can use the files, and the MIDI drops into an FM tracker or your own instruments.

Try it free

Three full tracks with their MIDI are free on this page: Lumen Town (a town), Battle and The Witch Unbound (the final boss). More free tracks from our other albums: Overture, the free sampler.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the tracks as music assets. Every track is composed in code and rendered through a General MIDI soundfont; the OGG files are a reference render, not FM synthesis and not chip emulation, and no generative audio model was used. The code and the cover art were made with AI tools. Every tune was composed for this record; no game cue or song is quoted.

Versions

v1.0 (1 November 2026): first release, 44 tracks.

devlog.title: Astral Grimoire is out: a 44 track fantasy RPG score written to the PC-98 sound budget
devlog.body:
Astral Grimoire is a 44 track music pack for fantasy RPGs, written inside the sound budget of a late 1980s PC-98 computer: one game from the title screen to the staff roll, towns, fields, five dungeons, three character themes, a battle set and four bosses, plus 6 short cues. It is live now, $9.99, with three full tracks free on the page.

The idea. Every track fits the YM2608 board: six FM voices, with three of them spent on a pad that plays the whole chord, one square wave arpeggio, and drums from the six sounds of the rhythm section and nothing else. The harmony is the fast functional kind that era's fantasy scores used: a new chord every bar, and a secondary dominant in every full piece (98 on the record), each moving straight to the chord it belongs to.

How it was checked. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, with the reports inside the download. The channel budget, the drum sounds, every secondary dominant and its three tones, and the seed theme in all 44 tracks were each measured on the shipped MIDI, and the loop tags were followed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project.

The OGG files are a General MIDI reference render, not FM synthesis and not chip emulation; the MIDI and CHANNEL_MAP.md are there so you can put it on your own FM patches. No game cue or song is quoted. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model was used; the cover art was made with AI tools.

https://csaf.itch.io/astral-grimoire
